title: Acme documentation frontmatter
description: Written by `ac docs init-schema` and then edited: Acme closed the contract, turned owner into its own list of teams, and added a tier of its own. Every enrolled repository is checked against this file, and a Python repository can enforce it with `jsonschema` without installing anything else.

owner.description: A team, not a person. People change teams; documents outlive them.

tier.description: critical means somebody may be paged while reading this.

about.description: Resources this document is about, as kind/id: event/<domain>/<id>, service/<name>, agent/<id>.
